references.text: Both verses mark the naming of places after divine encounters that define Jacob's identity.
Parallel in the naming of holy places after divine revelations to Jacob.
Thematic parallel in the patriarchs' practice of naming places to commemorate God's saving intervention.
Part of the same narrative sequence where God contacts Jacob before he arrives at Mahanajim.
Strong thematic parallel: Jacob's discovery of God's presence at a specific place before he names it.
